# Galaga Starfield — Verified Specification (hardware subsystem)

**Status: researched + palette fix applied 2026-06-21.** The starfield is a
**hardware** subsystem — the Z80 ROM only writes scroll/freeze bits; the star
**positions and colours are generated by the Namco star circuit**, not by code
(cf. the root CLAUDE.md "subsystem has no software counterpart" note). This doc
characterizes the hardware spec so the clone's approximation can be judged
against it, and records the applied palette fix.

Sources: Z80 = local disasm (`task_man.s`, `gg1-2_fx.s`); hardware = MAME
`historic-mame/src/mame/video/galaga.c` (`PALETTE_INIT(galaga)` + `star_seed_tab`).

---

## 1. The Z80 side — scroll / freeze only [verified, task_man.s:358-382, gg1-2_fx.s:1406-1464]

The ROM's entire involvement is the star-control port:

- `f_1D76` (gg1-2_fx.s:1414) sets `ds_99B9_star_ctrl[0]=1` when the ship is on
  screen, `=7` ("freeze", gg1-2_fx.s:1463) during attract / between events.
- `c_star_ctrl` (task_man.s:328-382) copies those bits to the **`$A000-$A005`**
  star port — *"starfield scroll speed (only bit 0 is significant)"* (task_man.s:359),
  `7 == star_ctrl_bits = frozen` (task_man.s:375).

**There is NO colour or position data in the ROM.** Everything visual is the
star circuit.

### 1.1 Capture scroll reversal [verified, gg1-3.s + gg1-2_fx.s:1423-1447]

During the tractor-beam **pull**, the stars scroll UP instead of down. The flag
`star_ctrl[1]` (RAM `99BA`) drives it: `f_1D76` reads it each frame
(gg1-2_fx.s:1423-1426) and, when nonzero, forces the scroll value to the reverse
direction (`A = 0xFD` → the `neg` at :1447) instead of the normal ramped
down-scroll. It is toggled at three points in the capture code:

| Event | Line | `star_ctrl[1]` | Stars |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beam latches ship, **pull begins** (`f_20F2` on, `captr_flag = 0x0A`) | `l_236D` gg1-3.s:691 | **= 1** | **UP** |
| Ship reaches boss → **fighter captured** (`f_19B2` carry-home) | `l_2305` gg1-3.s:626 | = 0 | DOWN |
| Boss **shot mid-capture** (abort) | `l_2327` gg1-3.s:645 | = 0 | DOWN |

So the up-scroll spans exactly the pull window — from beam-latch to
ship-connect/abort.

## 2. Star colours — the 2-2-2 RGB palette [verified, MAME PALETTE_INIT(galaga)]

Each star is a **6-bit colour**: 2 bits per gun (R, G, B). Each 2-bit gun is
mapped through the resistor-network levels:

```c
static const int map[4] = { 0x00, 0x47, 0x97, 0xde };
//  R = map[(col>>0)&3]   G = map[(col>>2)&3]   B = map[(col>>4)&3]
```

- Four levels per channel: **`0x00, 0x47, 0x97, 0xDE`** (0, 71, 151, 222).
- 4³ = **64 colours**, at palette indices 32-95. `(0,0,0)` is the invisible
  black star → **63 visible, full-spectrum** (red/green/blue/yellow/cyan/
  magenta/white + every mix).

This is the "2-2-2 RGB star circuit." The old clone palette (blue/purple/white
tints) was an approximation of "6 colours"; the real circuit is full-spectrum.

## 3. Star generation — positions, sets, blink [verified, MAME star_seed_tab]

- **`star_seed_tab[252]`** = 4 sets × 63 stars. Each record is
  `{ x, y, colourIndex (0-63), set (0-3) }` — **fixed** positions + colours, not
  random.
- **Two sets visible at once** (126 stars): `set_a = starcontrol[3]`,
  `set_b = starcontrol[4] | 0x2`; a star draws if its `.set` matches either.
  Toggling which sets are active is the **twinkle / blink**.
- One vertical scroll speed (the `$A000` bits) — **no parallax** in hardware.

## 4. Clone — applied palette fix (`tasks/starfield.js`)

**Fixed (2026-06-21):** replaced the `COLORS_SLOW`/`COLORS_FAST` blue/purple/white
tint arrays with the faithful **63-colour 2-2-2 RGB set**, generated from
`STAR_LEVELS = [0x00,0x47,0x97,0xDE]`. Both scroll layers now draw from the same
set (brightness comes from the colour, e.g. `(0x47,0,0)` dim red vs
`(0xDE,0xDE,0xDE)` white — *not* from the layer). Verified live: 42 distinct
full-spectrum colours drawn from 63 stars, no errors.

**Also fixed — capture scroll reversal (§1.1):** during the tractor-beam pull the
field reverses to scroll UP. The clone keys off `state.tasks.pullShip`, which is
true for exactly that window (set `tractorBeam.js:168` = `l_236D`; cleared
`pullShip.js:56/91` = `l_2305` and `tractorBeam.js:60` = `l_2327`). Implementation:
`dir = state.tasks.pullShip ? -1 : 1` with both-edge wrap. Verified: a 40-frame
down-scroll then an equal up-scroll returns the field **exactly** to its start
(63/63 stars), confirming the reversal cleanly undoes the forward scroll.

## 5. Deferred — the full seed-table / blink model

The palette is now faithful; the **model** is still an approximation, left as a
separate (larger) fidelity item:

- Clone uses **random** star positions/colours; hardware uses the fixed
  `star_seed_tab[252]`.
- Clone uses a **2-speed parallax** (slow/fast layers, 63 stars total); hardware
  uses **one** scroll speed and **126** stars (2 of 4 sets of 63).
- Clone has **no blink**; hardware twinkles by toggling the active sets.

Porting that = transcribe `star_seed_tab` (252 records) + a 4-set/2-active blink
toggle + single-speed scroll. Worth it only if the twinkle/density is wanted;
the colour fix alone already removes the most visible divergence (the blue cast).
